llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must create a dedicated runtime with `createWorkletRuntime(...)` and schedule compute onto it with `scheduleOnRuntime(runtime, worklet, ...)`, not deprecated `runOnRuntime`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createWorkletRuntime is called correctly, but the runtime is used via runOnRuntimeAsync instead of the required scheduleOnRuntime(runtime, worklet, ...).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge runtime results back to React with `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Results are bridged back to React using the deprecated runOnJS, not the required scheduleOnRN from react-native-worklets.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN` calls behind an explicit cadence condition (for example modulo/batch checkpoints plus final batch) instead of calling `scheduleOnRN` on every compute iteration.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Bridge calls are gated by a modulo condition (every BRIDGE_EVERY_N_BATCHES=4 batches) plus a final call after the last batch, preventing per-iteration bridging.
evidence: runOnJS(onProgress)(totalBatches, sum); // final call after loop
